mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies by City Hall and a Waxing Gibbous moon, with temperatures at 55 degrees. Overnight, we will drop to a low of 50 degrees and see some rain.

The city has shared important holiday reminders, noting that city offices will be closed November 26 and 27, which will also impact refuse and recycling pickup. Additionally, the city is evaluating a new Public Works and Utilities facility to better support our expanding community.

Looking at the calendar, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run tomorrow or Lake Lou-ee on Sunday. Next week, join us for Yoga at Insight Wellness on Sunday, or test your wits at several trivia nights happening throughout the city on Tuesday and Wednesday.
On November 2, officers responded to a domestic disturbance in the 100 block of West End Circle, resulting in the arrest of a 48-year-old local man for battery and disorderly conduct.
Today's flavor of the day was Crazy for Cookie Dough. As the shop is now closed for the night, please join us tomorrow starting at 10:00 AM when we will feature OREO Cookie Overload.
